caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped object centered on a plain, light beige background. Within the oval, there is a detailed rendering in shades of brown and gray, resembling a bas-relief or carved surface. The central composition inside the oval features a cluster of round, grape-like shapes tightly arranged together, forming the bulk of the image. Surrounding this cluster are textured, leaf-like forms with visible veins and some curling edges, and a thick, twisted stem that expands toward the bottom. The overall shading gives the objects a three-dimensional effect, making the cluster and leaves appear raised from the background. The object is bordered by a smooth, thick oval frame that separates the detailed inner design from the plain outer area. No other elements or colors are present in the image.
